title: Shifted Mellin Bridge Decomposition, Diagonal Stieltjes Tail Bounds, and Off-Diagonal Obstructions for Euler-Sieved Approximations to Riemann's Xi-Function
description: Applies Riemann's classical symmetry-point integral split to the Euler-sieved Jacobi-theta kernel of Xi(t - i*d)*E_X(s), obtaining an exact three-part decomposition into incomplete-Gamma shells, an unsieved reflected branch E_X(s)*F_+(1 - s), and a compact Gaussian-damped bridge integral. Derives unconditional Rosser-Schoenfeld Stieltjes upper bounds for the forward L^2 diagonal prime tail on X >= sqrt(N(t)) together with Mertens' harmonic benchmark, and proves four structural obstructions (reflected-branch asymmetry, divergence of the true n^{-1/2}-weighted L^1 sum for 0 < d < 1/2, destructive off-diagonal cross-terms, and Voronin universality) showing why single-mode confocal-ellipse identities cannot establish off-critical zero-freeness.
